companies.title: Company career pages
companies.description: One per line. Paste the career page address (for example https://boards.greenhouse.io/stripe, https://jobs.lever.co/palantir, https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/ramp, https://apply.workable.com/huggingface) or use the short form system:name (greenhouse:stripe, lever:palantir, ashby:ramp, workable:huggingface). Leave empty to try the tool on a built-in starter list.

titleIncludes.title: Job title must contain (any of)
titleIncludes.description: Keep a job only if its title contains at least one of these words or phrases. Not case sensitive. Leave empty to keep every title.

titleExcludes.title: Job title must not contain
titleExcludes.description: Drop a job if its title contains any of these words or phrases. Not case sensitive.

locationIncludes.title: Location must contain (any of)
locationIncludes.description: Keep a job only if one of its locations contains at least one of these words (for example a city, state or country). Not case sensitive. Leave empty to keep every location.

remoteOnly.title: Remote jobs only
remoteOnly.description: Keep only jobs the company marks as remote.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within the last N days
postedWithinDays.description: Keep only jobs published in the last N days. 0 keeps every job. Jobs without a publish date are kept.

onlyNewSinceLastRun.title: Only jobs that are new since the last run
onlyNewSinceLastRun.description: Remembers which jobs it has already returned for you and returns only the ones it has not seen before. Useful on a schedule: each run gives you just the new openings. The first run returns everything.

includeDescription.title: Include the full job description
includeDescription.description: Adds the job description as plain text. Turn off for smaller, faster results.

includeDescriptionHtml.title: Also include the description as HTML
includeDescriptionHtml.description: Adds the original formatted description. Only used when the full description is included.

maxJobsPerCompany.title: Maximum jobs per company
maxJobsPerCompany.description: Stop after this many matching jobs for each company. 0 means no limit.
